lines: You brought me back without needing the worst of it. Restraint is a weapon too.
Home again, whole enough to thank you properly. That matters.
We came back with the village still ahead of us. I'll count that as good work.
I came back marked. Next time, keep the edge between us and danger.
I made it home, but the road took more from me than it should have.
Next time, let us return with fewer marks and better choices.
I respect sharp steel. I do not respect turning it on someone who followed you.
Following you was trust. What happened after was something else.
A guide who strikes from close by leaves the longest mark.
A boat is not armor, but it kept danger at a decent distance.
The boat did its part. I am still deciding whether the rest of the plan did.
Water carried us home, which is more than I expected from that journey.
